title: Inventory Batch Editing, Location Relocation & Quick Spoiled Disposal
acceptance_criteria: Extend backend PATCH /api/v1/inventory/items/{id} to support updating location (Fridge, Freezer, Pantry), expiration date (ExpiresAt), and exact quantity, while enforcing If-Match ETag concurrency validation.
Automatically clean up or archive inventory items when quantity drops to 0, preventing orphaned zero-quantity records in PostgreSQL.
Add EditInventoryModal in React frontend allowing users to edit batch location, expiration date, or quantity with one click.
In InventoryItemCard, add quick action 'Списати як зіпсоване' (calls DELETE with reason=SPOILED), recording an OutboxMessage event.
Make freshness overview cards (Критичні, Збігають скоро, Свіжі) interactive click filters in InventoryDashboard.
Add sorting dropdown in InventoryDashboard: 'За терміном придатності (FEFO)', 'За назвою (А-Я)', 'За кількістю'.
Move dev-only '409 Тест' button out of the primary card view into an optional debug toggle or testbench.
